g.text: Top row: satisfiable formulas (the tool must find a counterexample). Bottom row: unsatisfiable formulas (it must prove the property). Beyond the benchmark sizes only α,β-CROWN (MIP) was run.

g.text: Where a line dips and recovers, a run hung before the solver started; the diagnostic re-runs in summary.md solved most of these.
